## Wakt 1.0.16

- **Lock screen shows the session's own apps.** The app a "Pause and lock" is locked to now appears in the lock screen's app row, next to Phone, Messages and your default allowed apps, so you can actually open it. This applies to any lock session with its own allowed apps.
- **Pause dialog remembers your choice.** The mode, the app and the durations you picked last time are pre-filled the next time you open it, with the remembered app pinned to the top of the list.
